independent_invariant: ONE_STEP_PRIMITIVE_RADIAL_EDGE: e is an elementary native lattice edge incident to O_E
length_definition: L_pre(e)=1 exactly for primitive radial edges e=[O_E,p]; this is the signed-origin primitive adjacency meaning and does not invoke AK orbit membership
preservation: Every primary AR transition replaces the current radial primitive edge by the other radial primitive edge of an origin-star triangle, so L_pre=1 is preserved exactly at every stored state.
free_endpoint_class: the non-origin endpoint of every stored segment edge is one of the six A1 one-step anchors
non_axis_intermediate_endpoint: not required as a stored native point; the between-anchor sweep state is represented by the side triangle C rather than by inventing a source-continuous endpoint
scope: complete for the one-step signed-origin segment model; no claim is made here that the same invariant classifies radius-r non-axis segment states for r>1
